prose: A Democratic sweep of the US Congress pulled down Asian tech stocks as investors rethought trades built around the Trump agenda for AI infrastructure and crypto, per Bloomberg. Global markets pared the selloff as investors weighed tougher scrutiny.
highlights: Asian tech stocks fell after a Democratic sweep of Congress
Trades tied to Trump's AI-infrastructure and crypto agenda rethought
basis: Error cache: Bloomberg paywall/bot-block. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
